main_text.p: fructus unquam in sobole pro-creāda constitutus est. hoc enim cum bestijs cōmune habet. éx ea igit re illarū fructus estimatur, ac cēsetur, q ipsarū est proprius, ac singularis: & quo cæteris animantib. ante cellūt, nimirū ex industria & opera. F. At usufructuarij omnis utilitas est, quæcūq; ex mulhere[?] capi potest, siue principaliter, siue secūdario ea nascatur. D. An cūm usufru-ctuarij sit omnis ancillarum utilitas, etiam illarum partus ipsius esse debeant. Quæ cō-trouersia ex ratiocinatione petitoris nascitur, similem est se rationem argumentantis, usu-

page.notes: Running head is ornamented and not legible on the scan. "mulhere" is doubtful; it may be "muliere". The line "igit re" is printed with a space as shown. "cellūt" is printed this way. The text ends with "usu-" at the foot of the page; the word continues on the next page. Long s has been normalised to s. Speaker marks "F." and "D." are kept as printed in the text.
